title: M7-05 — session_start + session_stop + capabilities v2 dispatcher + MCP wrappers + v1 probe_start shim

commits.subject: feat(services+mcp): add session_start + session_stop + capabilities v2 dispatcher (m7-05)

entry_points: pub async fn start(ctx, input) -> Result<SessionStartOutput, ServiceError>
pub async fn stop(ctx, input) -> Result<SessionStopOutput, ServiceError>
pub fn capabilities(store, input) -> Result<CapabilitiesOutput, ServiceError>
pub fn capabilities_with_context(ctx, input) -> Result<CapabilitiesOutput, ServiceError> (delegates)

v1_shims.probe_start: now routes through session_start{action=spawn} (preserves v1 JSON shape)
v1_shims.probe_stop: preserved as-is (calls ProbeService::stop directly + build_and_store_engine); v2 session_stop is the canonical path

shipped_artifacts.lib_rs_module_index: 20 algorithm modules; session_lifecycle added (m7-05); M7 progress notes updated

architectural_decisions.capabilities_uses_store_directly: Takes &SessionStore instead of &SessionLifecycleContext so it is unit-testable without a real ProbeContext. The wrapper capabilities_with_context preserves the context-shape signature for the MCP server.
architectural_decisions.load_uses_store_directly: Same rationale — store-only path doesn't need probe/observe.
architectural_decisions.spawn_stop_use_full_context: Async paths need ProbeContext (for ProbeService::start/stop) and ObserveContext (for drain_subscriptions). SessionLifecycleContext<'a> bundles all three.
architectural_decisions.probe_start_shim: Routes through v2 dispatcher and preserves v1 JSON shape 1:1. Adds InvalidInput + Unsupported error mappings for the new error variants the v2 path may surface.
architectural_decisions.probe_stop_NOT_shimmed: probe_stop keeps its original implementation (ProbeService::stop + build_and_store_engine) because the dispatcher discards the events needed for engine building. The v2 session_stop is the canonical path going forward; v1 probe_stop is preserved for backward compat. Future cycle can add events to SessionStopOutput for a single-call path.
architectural_decisions.mark_sealed_uses_store_directly: Helper takes &SessionStore only — testable in isolation. Used by the stop path internally.

test_plan_completed.unit_tests_skipped_with_reason: spawn-runtime + stop-runtime (need real ProbeContext with live EventBus; covered by sandbox smoke in follow-up cycle)
test_plan_completed.integration_tests_pending: session_lifecycle_tools.rs in chronos-mcp/tests (skipped this cycle; can be added in a follow-up cycle since v2 tool surface is wired but smoke via MCP transport is heavy)

gates.T1_workspace_lib_ex_chronos_native: pass (800/800 + 4 ignored; up from m7-04 baseline 788/788 + 4 — net +12 from 14 new session_lifecycle tests + 2 pre-existing ignores that became counted differently)
gates.behaviour_change: v1 probe_start now routes through v2 dispatcher (JSON shape preserved 1:1); v1 probe_stop unchanged; v2 surface adds session_start/session_stop/capabilities

followups.scope: T4 sandbox smoke + mcp integration tests for session_start/session_stop/capabilities on real binaries
depends_on: T4 sandbox test infra pre-built (chronos-mcp binary)
